name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
title: 5paisa Capital Ltd - 540776 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Broking-platform read: F&O premium up 22% QoQ to INR 1,336 crore and client funding book up 8% to INR 410 crore, but PAT fell to INR 44.3 crore on tech and HR spend and no capacity signal is given.

triggers.label: F&O premium up 22% QoQ
triggers.quote: in Q4, our F & O premium growth grew to INR 1,336 crores, which is an increase of 22% QoQ

triggers.label: Rights issue raised INR 468 crore
triggers.quote: amount of money raised was INR 468 crores

red_flags.label: Profit down on tech and HR spend; PAT INR 44.3 crore
red_flags.quote: Our profit is slightly declined because of tech investment as well as HR investment

red_flags.label: Mutual fund AUM down 6% QoQ
red_flags.quote: Our MF stood at INR 1,761 crores, which is again a 6% decrease from a QoQ perspective

evasions.quote: Just request if people are not speaking and go on mute.
